description: Membership of one user in one organisation (G-160). Membership evidence and the enterprise-sso-required role come from an active record. A user has at most one active record in one organisation. The record holds no secret.

fields.description: Organisation identifier, the same value as the organization field of PLT Enterprise IdP Exception. There is no organisation record yet.
fields.label: Organization

fields.description: The member. The membership never moves to another user.
fields.label: User

fields.description: active: the user is a member now. ended: the membership is over and gives nothing.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: The user who added the membership. The system writes it.
fields.label: Added By

name: PLT Organization Membership
